annotations.title: Purchase evidence: what a product page showed

description: Purchase evidence: what a product page showed. Use when an agent is about to buy, or has just bought, from a public product or offer page, and needs a signed, dated record of the price, availability, identifiers and return policy the page declared, the returns, shipping and terms pages it linked to, and any instruction patterns in visible or hidden text, optionally bound to an order reference. Cost: 3 credits per call.

html.description: Submitted mode: the page HTML your agent was shown (up to 4,000,000 characters). Not fetched; recorded as caller_submitted, in a private record without outside timestamps. Use it where a merchant blocks automated fetches. Meant for agent runtimes calling the REST endpoint; a model cannot pass a whole page as an MCP tool argument.

include_policies.description: Default true: also record up to 3 same-origin returns, shipping, warranty or terms pages the product page links to.

mandate_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of a payment mandate or intent you hold (for example an AP2 cart mandate). Bound as supplied; PageVerified never sees the mandate.

order_ref.description: Your order or cart reference, up to 128 characters from letters, digits and ._:/#-. Records are publicly readable, so only its SHA-256 is bound into the record; keep the reference to show the match.

page_url.description: Submitted mode: the URL the HTML came from, as you claim it. Recorded as a claim, never fetched.

url.description: Observed mode: the public product or offer page, fetched by PageVerified. Supply url, or html with page_url.

name: purchase_evidence
